body.name: Synchronized local spectral pilot
body.construction: Run Definition \ref{def:chart-graph}. With \(a_b=|C_b||P_b|\), form the conformable anchor averages \[A_U=\sum_{b\in\mathcal B_n}a_b\operatorname{qf}_r((\widehat U_b)_{C_{0,n},\cdot})\widehat Q_b^U\in\mathbb R^{|C_{0,n}|\times r},\qquad A_V=\sum_{b\in\mathcal B_n}a_b\operatorname{qf}_r((\widehat V_b)_{P_{0,n},\cdot})\widehat Q_b^V\in\mathbb R^{|P_{0,n}|\times r},\] and set \(\overline U_0=\operatorname{qf}_r(A_U)\) and \(\overline V_0=\operatorname{qf}_r(A_V)\). Let \(\overline K_0=\overline U_0^{\top}(X_n^{(1)})_{C_{0,n}P_{0,n}}\overline V_0\in\mathbb R^{r\times r}\), take its lexicographic full singular-value decomposition \(P_0S_0Q_0^{\top}\), and define \(\overline F_0=\overline U_0P_0S_0^{1/2}\in\mathbb R^{|C_{0,n}|\times r}\) and \(\overline G_0=\overline V_0Q_0S_0^{1/2}\in\mathbb R^{|P_{0,n}|\times r}\). Put \(R_b=I_b\cup C_b\) and \(S_b=P_b\cup Q_b\). First compute \(F_b^{(0)}=(X_n^{(1)})_{R_bP_{0,n}}\overline G_0(\overline G_0^{\top}\overline G_0)^{\dagger}\in\mathbb R^{|R_b|\times r}\) and \(G_b^{(0)}=((X_n^{(1)})_{C_{0,n}S_b})^{\top}\overline F_0(\overline F_0^{\top}\overline F_0)^{\dagger}\in\mathbb R^{|S_b|\times r}\). Refine them in the same gauge by \[F_b=(X_n^{(1)})_{R_bP_b}G_{b,P_b}^{(0)}(G_{b,P_b}^{(0)\top}G_{b,P_b}^{(0)})^{\dagger}\in\mathbb R^{|R_b|\times r},\qquad G_b=((X_n^{(1)})_{C_bS_b})^{\top}F_{b,C_b}^{(0)}(F_{b,C_b}^{(0)\top}F_{b,C_b}^{(0)})^{\dagger}\in\mathbb R^{|S_b|\times r}.\] For each row \(i\), let \(\mathcal B_i^F=\{b:i\in R_b\}\), and if nonempty set \(\widetilde F_i=\sum_{b\in\mathcal B_i^F}\lambda_{ib}^FF_{b,i\cdot}\), where \(\lambda_{ib}^F=|P_b|/\sum_{c\in\mathcal B_i^F}|P_c|\). For each column \(t\), let \(\mathcal B_t^G=\{b:t\in S_b\}\), and if nonempty set \(\widetilde G_t=\sum_{b\in\mathcal B_t^G}\lambda_{tb}^GG_{b,t\cdot}\), where \(\lambda_{tb}^G=|C_b|/\sum_{c\in\mathcal B_t^G}|C_c|\). Empty aggregates are the zero row, sums follow lexicographic chart order, and ties in every decomposition use the declared lexicographic rule. Set \(\widetilde X_{it}=\widetilde F_i\widetilde G_t^{\top}\) on \(\Omega_n\) and \(\widetilde X_{it}=0\) on \(W_n\). Finally, use \(\mathcal A_n=\{C_{0,n}\times P_{0,n}\}\cup\{C_b\times P_b,(I_b\cup C_b)\times P_{0,n},C_{0,n}\times(P_b\cup Q_b):b\in\mathcal B_n\}\), all of whose rectangles are observed under the common-anchor design. For \(A\in\mathcal A_n\), set \(\varepsilon_A=\sqrt{2}\sigma\{\sqrt{|\operatorname{row}(A)|}+\sqrt{|\operatorname{col}(A)|}+\sqrt{2\log(8(|\mathcal B_n|+1)/\alpha)}\}\) and \(\varepsilon_n=\max_{A\in\mathcal A_n}\varepsilon_A\). Let \(a_{\mathrm{sync},n}=1\) when \( |\mathcal B_n|=1\), and \(a_{\mathrm{sync},n}=1+d_{\mathrm{chart}}/\gamma_{\mathrm{graph}}\) otherwise, and define the proved post-synchronization envelope \(\tau_n=32a_{\mathrm{sync},n}\varepsilon_n\). Thus the generic second-order bound uses \(\tau_n^2\), which squares the graph amplification. Define \[\widehat\delta_n=\min_{A\in\mathcal A_n}\{s_r((X_n^{(1)})_A)-2\varepsilon_A\}_+,\qquad \widehat M_n=\max_{A\in\mathcal A_n}\{\lVert\Pi_r((X_n^{(1)})_A)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}+\varepsilon_A\}.\]
